q.g: The Flash drive marked with blue tape can be found in Sanitar's room in The Lab. The room is located on the second floor, directly across from the laboratory block (G22) and requires a Keycard with a blue marking to enter. In Sanitar's room, the Flash drive marked with blue tape is stuck into the laptop that is located on the left desk after you enter.

sh.c: Flash drive plugged into the laptop
